headline: Space Bunny hits 18.2%, three new models enter top 50
summary: stealth/space-bunny-alpha just claimed its third consecutive day atop the leaderboard with 18.2% token share—an all-time high. Meanwhile, the top two providers (DeepSeek and stealth) now command 39.5% of the market between them. Three fresh entrants landed in the rankings today: qwen/qwen3.8-27b-20260814, nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b-20230311:free, and mistralai/mistral-nemo.
highlights: stealth/space-bunny-alpha extends its reign to day 3 with 18.2% share, the highest token share ever recorded on OpenRouter
openai/gpt-6-luna-20260922 marks day 4 of its own all-time high at 3.1% share
DeepSeek and stealth together hold 39.5% of tokens; top three (adding OpenAI) reach 51.2%
Three dropouts: openai/gpt-5.6-terra-20260709, anthropic/claude-4.6-sonnet-20260217, and google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it-20260403
OpenAI gained 0.8% share day-over-day; Zhipu AI shed 4.1% in the same window
